Script walk v6.3: every line on its own board; turns and promises as predicates. Brain: P1 every part on its own source's board (close → answered card's answerBoard; remediation simpler/say → remediation board, then-card on its own page; probe → answered card; a line naming a figure → the board drawing it; no page switch inside a sentence); T1′ predicate 0 turns with two closes and 0 closes for a card not answered in the child's preceding turn (missed close dropped); H2′ canned aside facts deleted, return only after a park, at the promised point, reusing a content word of the child's aside; H1′ escalate miss 1 simpler → miss 2 remediation say → miss 3 answer with why, no line twice per card, only the live card's simpler after it is posed; W1 no answer before the child's turn, worked examples pose the question; R1 single-page verdicts draw the answerBoard; R2 code ack unless confident, Hindi number agreement, no raw park template; harness reads what is drawn. Studio: S1 second views keep the asked mark's position and scale labels (A1 hides only the key's value); S2 captions from drawn titles, real shade-grid second view, a line naming the original figure brings it back; S3 board labels switch with Hindi. Learning: D1 judgement-card answerBoards draw the judged figure with its answer state (beside the equal one when contrasted); D2 a why naming a figure must match its answerBoard; D3–D5 c5-t02 c3 on lines, c5-t01 'Bhinn hisse…' reworded, c4 borderline lines checked. Why: director11 passes beats/verdicts/misgrades/false keys for the sixth run and drawing fell 44→12, but 36 contradictions remain (paging 13, data 13, second view 9, model words 1) and register/promises fail in every topic because v6.2's T1 and H2, built as behaviour, did not hold. Reverse: director12 still shows more than 10 paging + second-view contradictions with P1 and S1–S3 in place → one code-drawn board per card, held (the v6.2 clause); or model-written words exceed 10 → board sentences move to a code voice (the v6.1 clause).

director11: v6.2 on integration 14a + Studio's pager. 16 lessons, counted by hand by 4 judges.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-script-walk-v6-3` (2026-11-08)

Every line goes on its own board; turns and promises become predicates.

**Brain:**
- **P1:** every part on its own source's board, and no page switch inside a sentence.
- **T1′:** zero turns with two closes, and no close for a card not answered in the child's preceding turn. A missed close is dropped.
- **H2′:** no canned aside facts. Return only after a park, at the promised point, reusing the child's own word.
- **H1′:** escalate simpler → remediation say → answer with its why. Never repeat a line, and only the live card's simpler after it is posed.
- **W1:** no answer before the child's turn. Worked examples pose their question.
- **R1:** single-page verdicts draw the answerBoard.
- **R2:** a code acknowledgement unless confident; Hindi number agreement; no raw park template.

**Studio:**
- **S1:** second views keep the asked mark's position and the scale labels.
- **S2:** captions come from drawn titles; shade-grid gets a real second view.
- **S3:** labels switch with Hindi.

**Learning:**
- **D1:** judgement-card answerBoards draw the judged figure with its answer state.
- **D2:** a why naming a figure must match its answerBoard.
- **D3–D5:** targeted fixes.

**Why:** director11 passed beats, verdicts, misgrades and false keys for the sixth run, and drawing fell 44 → 12. But 36 contradictions remain, and register and promises fail in every topic, because v6.2's T1 and H2 did not hold.

**Reverse if:** director12 still has more than 10 paging plus second-view contradictions with P1 and S1–S3 in place. Then the board becomes one code-drawn board per card, held. If model-written words exceed 10, board sentences move to a code voice.
